repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: YAO = Yielding AI Outcomes. A rigorous engineering, evaluation, governance, and portability system for reusable agent skills.
repos.summary_zh: YAO是AI智能体技能的可复用工程与治理系统，将重复工作流打包为跨平台技能包。2.0升级为Skill OS，提供技能IR中间表示、目标编译器、评估证据库、发布门禁和技能生命周期治理，实现从创建到迭代的完整闭环。
repos.summary_en: YAO is a rigorous engineering and governance system for reusable AI agent skills. Version 2.0 upgrades to a Skill OS with platform-neutral IR, target compilers, evaluation evidence lab, release gates, and full lifecycle governance — turning repeated workflows into installable, cross-platform skill packages.

repos.description: ✨ AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，致力于让个人收藏的 AI 提示词能够发挥最大价值。支持变量替换、Jinja 模板、AI 生成与调优、历史版本记录、云端备份等核心功能。
repos.summary_zh: AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，支持 Jinja 模板与变量动态替换，集成多种 AI 模型实现自动生成与调优提示词。所有数据本地存储，支持 WebDAV/iCloud 云端备份，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 多平台运行，帮助用户高效收藏与管理个人提示词资产。
repos.summary_en: AI Gist is a privacy-first AI prompt management tool featuring Jinja template support and dynamic variable substitution. It integrates multiple AI models for auto-generating and optimizing prompts, with all data stored locally. Cloud backup via WebDAV/iCloud is supported. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, it helps users efficiently collect and manage personal prompt assets.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2026] MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research · 浏览器里运行的安卓模拟器 · Browser-hosted Android Simulator · Verifiable Evaluation · Scalable Online RL Training
repos.summary_zh: MobileGym 是一个基于浏览器的可验证、高并行移动 GUI Agent 研究仿真平台。它提供 28 个模拟应用和 416 个参数化任务模板，支持确定性亚毫秒级评测，单服务器可并行运行 256 个实例，并通过 Sim-to-Real 验证实现 +40.7 分真实设备性能提升。
repos.summary_en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, verifiable and highly parallel simulation platform for mobile GUI agent research. It ships 28 simulated apps with 416 parameterized task templates, deterministic sub-millisecond judges, 256 parallel instances per server, and achieves +40.7 pt sim-to-real transfer on real devices.
